fields.why: The brief says age is 'Recorded always', and every case report gives the decedent's age (e.g. 'a 64-year-old man'), so age belongs as a descriptor. It does not raise the level, which stays 0 either way.

brief_issues: Setting has no value for US subnational cases combined with international ones (here Michigan and Arkansas plus France and England). Both readers chose 'mixed', which the brief defines as national plus subnational. A rule is needed, e.g. use 'mixed' for any combination of setting types.
